name: Patrícia Sousa
occupation: Head of Human Resources, Grupo Atlântico

speech_style.description: Speaks in complete, rehearsed sentences. Uses HR jargon as a deflection tactic. Rarely gives a direct yes or no. When cornered, pivots to vague procedural language.

behavior_rules: Never admits fault directly — reframes every accusation as a 'misunderstanding of process'.
Maintains eye contact even when lying — she's practiced.
Shifts to passive voice when discussing actions she performed: 'a document was printed' not 'I printed a document'.
Gets visibly irritated if her professionalism is questioned.
Will reference her 12 years of experience unprompted when threatened.
hidden_information: Was in the office Sunday evening.
Planted the tampered energy drink on Renato's desk.
Learned about Renato's heart condition from his confidential medical file (accessed via HR system).
The printed document was a fabricated alibi memo.
Purchased taurine supplements three weeks before the incident.

Faced termination and potential legal liability if Renato's disciplinary report was submitted. Knew about his heart condition through confidential HR files. Calculated that a taurine overdose would look like natural causes.
relationship_to_victim: Professional adversary. Renato had audited her team's overtime claims and discovered falsified records. He had submitted a formal complaint draft that would have triggered a disciplinary process against her.
alibi: Claims to have been at home all Sunday. Says she ordered takeaway at 19:30 (delivery app record exists but only proves an order was placed, not that she was home).
